Maintenance Fitter - South Nowra, NSW 
   
 Full-Time Permanent Opportunity | Food Manufacturing | Up to $40/hr base rate + shift loading + Super 
   
 Hays are currently partnering with a well-established food manufacturing business in South Nowra to recruit an experienced Maintenance Fitter to join their Engineering team. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for a trade-qualified fitter who enjoys a hands-on role, working across preventative maintenance, breakdown response, equipment upgrades and continuous improvement projects within a fast-paced production environment. 
 About the Role 
 Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will join a close-knit maintenance team consisting of Maintenance Fitters and a Maintenance Manager who oversees day-to-day operations. 
 Working across rotating shifts, you'll play a key role in ensuring production equipment operates safely and efficiently while supporting the installation and commissioning of a new manufacturing line. 
   
 Hours: 
 
 Full-time permanent position 
 37.5 hours per week 
 Rotating shifts:
 
 6:00am - 2:00pm 
 11:00am - 7:00pm 
 
 
 Flexibility to work both shifts is essential, although afternoon-focused arrangements may be considered following successful training. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Carry out preventative and scheduled maintenance on manufacturing equipment 
 Respond to machinery breakdowns, faults, jams and equipment failures 
 Troubleshoot and repair mechanical systems to minimise downtime 
 Assist with machinery installations, upgrades and improvement projects 
 Support the commissioning of a new gummies production line 
 Ensure machinery and components meet Australian safety standards 
 Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation 
 Promote and follow all workplace safety, GMP and food safety procedures 
 
 About You 
 To be successful in this role, you will have: 
 
 Trade qualification as a Mechanical Fitter or Maintenance Fitter 
 Previous experience working within a manufacturing environment 
 Strong fault-finding and breakdown maintenance capability 
 Experience with preventative maintenance programmes 
 Ability to work both independently and as part of a team 
 Commitment to workplace safety and continuous improvement 
 
 Highly Desirable 
 
 Food manufacturing experience 
 Understanding of GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) 
 Exposure to food safety and quality systems 
 Experience working with automated production equipment 
 Experience commissioning or installing new machinery 
 
 What's on Offer? 
 
 Permanent full-time employment 
 Competitive hourly rate up to $40 per hour + superannuation 
 Stable Monday to Friday roster 
 Opportunity to work on new production line installations 
 Supportive engineering team and leadership 
 Long-term career growth with a successful manufacturing business 
 
     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to David.lynes@hays.com.au, or call Dave on 0477551369 now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

Fit fabricated metal components and ensure correct alignment and tolerances.   Inspect completed fabrication work to ensure compliance with engineering specifications and quality standards.   Perform maintenance and repairs on buckets, booms, pins, bushes, agricultural machinery and earthmoving equipment.   Operate fabrication machinery including presses, grinders, drills, cutting equipment and other workshop machinery safely and efficiently.   Maintain a safe, clean and organised work environment while complying with workplace health and safety procedures. IT Systems & Support Technician (Industrial Automation)

About our client 

Kogan People Solutions has been retained by a leading automotive components manufacturer to recruit a highly focused tech professional for their automated production facility. Our client operates a state of  the art, continuous manufacturing environment where 100% of finished products undergo sophisticated, computer controlled validation before release. Due to operational expansion and the critical nature of their systems, we are seeking a dedicated IT Systems Support Technician to ensure their core industrial computing infrastructure remains online and optimized.

Role Overview
This is a highly specialized, business-critical role embedded directly within an advanced manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for the continuous, real-time monitoring of two advanced Turbo Test Duo balancing and calibration systems driven by embedded software platforms.

To confirm: This is not a mechanical repair position. The primary objective is the maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the highly integrated computer systems, hardware interfaces, and proprietary software that governs the physical machinery.

Location: Cheltenham, VIC

Job Type: Full-time, Ongoing 

Salary $80,000 – $90,000 + Superannuation  per annum.

Responsibilities 
•	Actively oversee and analyze the operation of embedded, computer-controlled industrial systems throughout the day.

•	Instantly respond to automated software alerts and digital system alarms to isolate faults across integrated computer hardware and data logging modules.

•	Resolve complex technical issues occurring within specialized proprietary software configurations and peripheral IT components.

•	Manage, verify, and update software profiles, system parameters, and computer calibration data to guarantee operational accuracy.

•	Maintain precise digital records of system errors, technical configurations, and software performance logs to feed into predictive risk management.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

•	Diploma, or higher qualification in a highly related IT discipline or agreed substitute

•	Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of professional experience supporting integrated computer networks, automated software platforms, or industrial IT hardware interfaces.

•	Proven experience interpreting real-time software diagnostics, system logs, and bi-directional hardware/software integration.

•	Strong ability to diagnose computing faults rapidly under pressure to minimize production downtime. 

•	Excellent communication skills to interface with production engineers.

•	Ability to prioritise, multitask and work independently.

•	A passion for learning and staying ahead of technology trends.

•	Ability to analyse and evaluate complex IT issues.

•	High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

You will have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to be considered. 

How to Apply

If you possess the specialized IT skills required to support critical, automated industrial computing infrastructure, Kogan People Solutions wants to hear from you. Accompanying your application, we would prefer to see a cover letter detailing your specific software and hardware troubleshooting experience

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

Ausgreen Solar Solutions is a renewable energy solutions provider operating across New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory, specialising in the supply of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and energy efficiency products for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The business provides tailored renewable energy solutions, technical product advice, and professional support to assist customers in adopting efficient and sustainable energy systems.

We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced Sales Representative (Industrial Products) to join our team on a full-time basis. This role is ideal for a technically minded sales professional who enjoys developing business relationships, promoting industrial products, providing product solutions, and achieving sales objectives within a growing renewable energy industry.

Why You'll Love This Role

The Opportunity
Join the School of Electrical Engineering and Telecommunications in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer or Senior Lecturer in a Teaching and Research role. You will contribute to research and teaching in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with a focus on learning paradigms, models, and architectures for electronic learning systems. You will also teach across undergraduate and postgraduate Electrical Engineering programs and undertake research in machine learning, artificial intelligence, electronic systems, complex adaptive systems, and related emerging technologies.

Position Details
• Salary:
o Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $133,065 to $156,864 per annum + 17% superannuation
o Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $161,619 to $185,422 per annum + 17% superannuation
• Employment type: Full-time
• Appointment type: Fixed term, 2-year convertible tenure track (Fixed-term appointment with the potential to convert to continuing employment, subject to a successful review.)
• Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia
• Reporting line: This role reports to the Head of School and has no direct reports.

About You
You are an academic with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, learning systems, or a closely related area, with the ability to contribute to high-quality research and teaching. You are committed to advancing your research profile while delivering engaging learning experiences in the fundamentals, practice, and future directions of artificial intelligence and machine learning for undergraduate and postgraduate students.

Success in this role requires a collaborative and adaptable approach, with the ability to work across disciplines, build relationships with industry and professional networks, and contribute to the continued development of the School’s research capability in learning systems. At Senior Lecturer level, you will also bring evidence of research leadership, a nationally recognised research track record, success in attracting competitive funding, and experience mentoring colleagues and supervising higher degree research students to completion.

About UNSW
UNSW is a leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige and impact. With strong industry engagement, it translates academic expertise into real-world outcomes. The School of Electrical Engineering and Telecommunications is recognised for excellence in teaching and research.

Skills and Experience
Level B
• A PhD in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related discipline, along with relevant work experience.
• Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
• Demonstrated experience and evidence in teaching and learning design, development and/or delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels in the fundamentals, practice, and future directions of artificial intelligence and machine learning.
• Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods.
• Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales).
• Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience of work-integrated learning (desirable).
• Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity and inclusion initiatives.
• Demonstrated track record in research with outcomes of high quality and high impact with clear evidence of the desire and ability to continually achieve research excellence as well as the capacity for research leadership.
• A track record of significant involvement with the profession and/or industry.
• High level communication skills and ability to network effectively and interact with a diverse range of students and staff.
• Demonstrated ability to work in a team, related to the future of machine learning such as mathematics, electronic systems, complex adaptive systems, etc.; and build effective relationships.
• Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
• An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
• Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Level C
• A PhD in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related discipline, along with relevant work experience.
• Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.

About the company

Zimmermann Industries is a leading Australian signage, branding and corporate identity specialist, established in 2007. The company delivers end-to-end solutions, managing every stage from concept and design through to fabrication, installation and maintenance. With strong foundations in traditional signwriting and advanced expertise in custom architectural, electronic and retail signage, Zimmermann Industries helps businesses maximise brand visibility and create lasting impressions. Known for innovation, quality craftsmanship and reliable service, the company has successfully delivered outstanding projects across diverse industries.

About the role

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Sales Representative to promote and grow our industrial signage, branding, and fabrication solutions. The role involves identifying new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, preparing quotations, conducting product presentations, and achieving sales targets. You will work closely with customers to understand their requirements and provide tailored solutions. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication and negotiation skills, a proactive approach to business development, and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service while driving revenue growth and market expansion.

About the position

Position: Sales Representative (Industrial Products)

Location of Work: 9 Trade Place, Lilydale, Vic -3140

Employment Type: Permanent, Full Time

Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus guaranteed superannuation

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Technical Assessment & Client Consultation: Review client concepts and architectural plans to assess technical needs, recommending the most suitable industrial fabrication methods, materials, and services to achieve the desired outcome. 
•	Commercial Quoting & Estimating: Scope out the true technical costs of manufacturing bespoke products on the factory floor. Prepare, quote, and negotiate accurate pricing for high-end retail and commercial signage projects.

•	Commercial Acumen: Strong foundation skills in product costing, with a willingness to be mentored in the commercial, quoting, and negotiating aspects of the business.

Location: Brisbane

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd, a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder, is looking for an experienced full-time Software Developer with a background in the logistics industry. You will build the systems that run our forwarding and customs operations, working hands-on with CargoWise, Expedient and modern AI tooling.

About the Company

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd is a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder with our Australian operations based in Brisbane. Technology sits at the centre of how we operate: we invest in automation, systems integration and practical AI to streamline forwarding and customs workflows, connect with partners and carriers, and deliver a faster, more accurate service to our customers. You will join an on-site team where your work goes straight into daily operations.

About the Role

This is a standalone role for a capable all-rounder who will oversee the technological advancement of the business. You will own our technology roadmap end to end: developing, testing, maintaining and documenting application code in line with user requirements and system and technical specifications, building integrations with our CargoWise and Expedient platforms, and embedding AI across our operations. You will work directly with the leadership team and operational staff, with the autonomy to choose the right tools and set the technical direction.

Key Responsibilities

•	Research, consult and analyse user, business and system requirements, and evaluate existing systems to identify deficiencies and recommend improvements.
•	Design, develop, test, debug, document and maintain program code in accordance with user requirements and system and technical specifications.
•	Build and maintain integrations with CargoWise (eAdapter, APIs, EDI, workflow and registry configuration) and Expedient, including data mapping, message handling and automation.
•	Develop and deploy AI-driven features such as document extraction, classification and workflow automation for logistics operations.
•	Write and maintain technical documentation, program specifications and test plans.
•	Support deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines and operational monitoring of production systems.
•	Identify and address security risks across the product lifecycle.
•	Advise leadership on technology strategy, evaluate emerging tools and platforms, and drive the company's digital roadmap.
•	Train and support operational staff in adopting new systems and AI tooling.


About You 

•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or at least 1-2 years of relevant professional experience with strong working knowledge of forwarding, customs and transport operations across air, sea and road.
•	Hands-on experience with CargoWise, including workflow configuration, eAdapter/API integration, EDI messaging or custom development.
•	Demonstrated experience developing with or integrating Expedient freight forwarding and customs software.
•	Experience building AI-enabled software with LangChain and with the models and APIs of all the modern frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and xAI), including intelligent document processing and workflow automation in production systems.
•	Strong experience with AWS for hosting, deployment and cloud services.
•	Strong proficiency in one or more modern languages and frameworks (e.g. Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node, SQL) and experience with REST APIs and EDI.
•	The self-direction to operate as the sole technical resource in the business, managing priorities and delivering without day-to-day technical supervision.
•	Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational logistics requirements into robust technical solutions.

What We Offer

•	Salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.
•	Real ownership of the systems you build, in a business applying AI to day-to-day freight operations.
•	A collaborative on-site team environment in Brisbane.
•	Ongoing professional development, including support for CargoWise certifications and AI and cloud training.

Determining job requirements and planning/configuring scaffolding
Undertake checking and assessing activities of scaffold prior to, during and at the completion of each build
Erecting lifting tackles by attaching pulleys and blocks to fixed overhead structures, and installing cables and attaching counterweights
Attaching slinging gear to hoisting equipment and objects to be moved using clamps, hooks, bolts and knots
Fitting and bolting tubes, support braces and components to form bases and build up scaffolding
Lifting and positioning sections of scaffolding
Carry out tasks within agreed time limits
Dismantling and removing on completion
Carry out tasks within agreed time limits

Setting up winches and rigging equipment to raise and position girders, plates, columns and other steel units

Help identify hazards, defects and the need for adjustment or repair; to ensure compliance with agreed codes, law, working practices and health and safety
Maintain accurate records of inspection and hand over
Where possible, rectify identified defects, failures, errors or omissions to scaffold structures. If not possible ensure reporting to the required personnel and restrict access to structure until such time the defect is rectified
Adhere to all organisational and customer policies, procedures and Safety Health Management System requirements

Demonstratable working experience of at least 3 years in a similar role within the Construction and Maintenance industries

Desirable: Any or combination of Work Platform (WP), Forklift Truck (LF), Intermediate Rigger (RI), Dogger (DG) or Non-Slew Crane (CN) High Risk Work Licence/s
Construction Industry Induction – Blue/White Card
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills

Desire to lead a highly driven team to achieve successful outcomes for both the customer and in turn, MI Scaffold
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
